Most people lose momentum just a couple of months after their first success. In the world of content, it happens even faster: today you're at the top, tomorrow you've been forgotten. Only a handful of people manage to stay at the top and turn a spike of attention into long-term success.

Today, Vova is known all over the world. His videos consistently generate hundreds of millions of views, his content gets recognized by the biggest names in the industry, and people on the level of Joe Rogan and Arnold Schwarzenegger follow his media.

📌 Basic Concepts of Technical Analysis: Understanding Price Movements

Main Points
⏺ Technical analysis helps traders predict future price movements based on historical data and market behavior.
⏺ Key concepts like trends, chart patterns, and indicators are essential for understanding the market.
⏺ This post breaks down the core concepts of technical analysis for beginners.

1️⃣ Trends
Uptrend: When prices are consistently rising.
Downtrend: When prices are consistently falling.
Sideways/Consolidation: When prices move within a range, showing no clear direction.
2️⃣ Support and Resistance
Support: A price level where buying pressure is strong enough to prevent further price declines.
Resistance: A price level where selling pressure prevents the price from rising further.
3️⃣ Chart Patterns
Head and Shoulders: A pattern that signals a trend reversal.
Double Top/Bottom: Indicates a potential reversal after a price reaches a high or low point twice.
4️⃣ Indicators and Oscillators
Moving Averages (MA): Smooth out price data to identify trends.
RSI (Relative Strength Index): Measures whether an asset is overbought or oversold.
MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence): Helps identify changes in momentum.
5️⃣ Volume: Volume represents the number of assets traded and can confirm the strength of a trend.

Final Thoughts

Technical analysis is a valuable tool for understanding price movements and making informed trading decisions. By learning to identify trends, support and resistance levels, and using key indicators, you can improve your trading strategy.

🔔 What are “the trenches”? A guide to Solana memecoin culture and slang 

⚠️ If you spend any time around Solana memecoins, you will hear about “the trenches.” It is where traders called degens fight over brand-new tokens that mostly go to zero, in a culture with its own language, rituals, and brutal economics. Here is what the trenches are, the slang you need to follow them, and the hard reality behind the romance.

➡️ “The trenches” is crypto slang for the chaotic, high-risk frontier of on-chain memecoin trading, especially the world of brand-new Solana tokens launched on platforms like Pumpfun, where traders fight for fast profits amid rampant scams, bots, and a flood of coins that mostly go to zero. 

📊 The phrase is a war metaphor, and it is chosen deliberately. To be “in the trenches” is to be down in the mud of the riskiest, fastest, most unforgiving part of crypto, trading tokens that are minutes old, against opponents who include automated bots and seasoned predators, where fortunes are made and lost in the time it takes to read a chart. It is a culture as much as an activity, with its own dense vocabulary, its own rituals and heroes, and its own grim economics.
